scope: Read-only historical screenshot review; not current-source qualification or visual approval.

source.identityAuthority: Exact file hashes, not commit-only attribution; the original manifest base metadata and native-receipt base are preserved separately.

summary.caveat: A screenshot review is not a functional pass. Implementation presence is not visual approval; small rendering causes are unproven.

method.inspection: All 18 expected/actual/diff comparison sheets visually inspected; original PNGs retained.
method.dimensionsAndRawRgba: Original Make-built image, network none; raw RGBA differences are not Playwright thresholds.
method.sheetReduction: Factor two only for source widths above 800; original PNGs unchanged.

invalidBindInvocation.classification: MODULE_NOT_FOUND before PNG decoding; unavailable daemon-side bind path, not browser or native compiler failure.

sourceExplanations.providers: EcosystemSettings.tsx:184 explicitly renders the collapsed CacheNoticeSettings summary before provider cards.
sourceExplanations.navigation: Sidebar.tsx explicitly renders linked-directory/open actions and sidebar organisation controls.
sourceExplanations.files: WorkspacePanel.tsx retains explorer controls and open-file tabs; workspace-panel.css:56 reserves tree space with an open viewer.
sourceExplanations.border: Frozen child-panel test already rounds origin and clears hover. No new timing/root-cause claim.
sourceExplanations.existingPresentationLimits: Mobile Settings-heading overlap and desktop provider actions projecting left of their card are visible before and after; not new differences or certified layouts.

acceptance.recommendation: Obtain explicit decisions on enumerated feature/layout changes, especially reduced mobile preview space; separately decide seven minor metric/border cases against the final frozen rendering. Only subsequently authorized reviewed baseline updates may be generated in Docker. No tolerance increase or blanket update.
acceptance.nextGate: Complete same-source Docker typecheck/public parity/root/nine-browser-suite/production/native-smoke campaign, source/image sealing and explicit CI status; no third-party investigation.
acceptance.retainedFailures: All historical screenshot, nonvisual browser, root and native failures retain their original status. Post-screenshot assertions are not credited.

items.observation: Same dimensions, selections, budget, limits and disabled reasons; small vertical label/control/help offsets, no demonstrated functional loss.
